text: There are three dentists, and they are all kind. However, I would like to criticize the equipment: the dental beds are still old-fashioned and not as modern as other hospitals. Furthermore, there are no mouthwash stations for patients. There are no separate rooms for government officials and the general public, as many people go there for dental treatment. They should change the dental beds and equipment to be better. Truly living up to its name, the International Dental Center, would be great.

restaurant_name: ศูนย์ทันตสาธารณสุขระหว่างประเทศ
text: I brought my mother here and was told we needed to book an appointment. We couldn't book by phone; we had to come in person. They told us to get a queue number at 6 am. When we arrived, there was no one there. We waited until 8 am, and as soon as they opened, the queue was full. This is unacceptable service. We live far away and arrived at 5 am. I'm very disappointed.
